info.name: Version1
info.description:
Complete test suite for FR-7 Matching Service.

Setup:
  1. Open Collection Variables and set `zipFilePath` to the full path of EzzyHub-TestProject.zip on your machine.
  2. Start all services: Python :8000 → Req Analyzer :8081 → Code Analyzer :8082 → Matching :8083.
  3. Run the collection in order (01 → 02 → 03 → 04).

Expected results with EzzyHub-TestProject.zip:
  FR-2.x → IMPLEMENTED or PARTIAL  (GitHub import, ZIP upload, project structure — all coded)
  FR-4.x → IMPLEMENTED or PARTIAL  (Java parsing, annotations, methods — all coded)
  FR-3.x → MISSING                 (no NLP/requirement processing code in the project)
  FR-7.x → MISSING                 (no matching service code in the project)

---

ADDED IN THIS VERSION — folders 06, 07, 08:

06 — API Gateway (port 8085): confirms each downstream route's path-rewrite rules, the aggregate /api/health panel, unmatched-route 404s, the hidden actuator/gateway/routes endpoint, and the global per-IP rate limiter.

07 — Auth Service (port 8087): register/login happy paths and validation errors (duplicate email, bad email format, short password, missing name), plus /me with a valid, missing, and malformed token.

08 — Report Service (port 8086): save/list/get/delete a report and download its PDF, each with a with-token and without-token case, plus not-found cases.

Run order for 07 → 08 → 06: Auth Service AUTH-2 (or AUTH-7) first to populate {{authToken}}, then Report Service, then API Gateway's GW-6/GW-7/GW-8 (which reuse the same token/zip variables). All new services also need their ports running: auth-service :8087, report-service :8086, api-gateway :8085, plus MySQL for both auth-service and report-service (shared ezzyhub_db).

---

ADDED IN THIS VERSION — folder 09:

09 — AI-Suggestions Service (ezzyhubai): generate/iterate Spring Boot code from a matching-service report + project ZIP (OpenAI-backed). Covers the from-match generation flow, version listing/retrieval, per-version file listing, the chat-based iteration endpoint, single-version and full-batch ZIP downloads, and two validation-error cases.

⚠️ Before running folder 09: this service's checked-in application.properties hardcodes a live OpenAI API key and a DB password, and defaults to port 8086 — the same port report-service uses. See the project README ("Running AI-Suggestions") for the required env-var and port fix before starting it.

item.name: 09 — AI-Suggestions Service (port 8086 in code / run on 8088)
item.description:
Endpoints for the AI-Suggestions microservice (Backend/AI-Suggestions/ezzyhubai) — generates and iterates Spring Boot code from a matching-service report + project ZIP, using OpenAI.

⚠️ PORT COLLISION: this service's own application.properties has server.port=8086, the SAME port report-service uses. Start it with server.port=8088 (see README) — {{ai_suggestions_url}} already points at 8088.

⚠️ SECRETS: the checked-in application.properties also contains a live OpenAI API key and a DB password in plaintext. Rotate the key and move both to environment variables before running this service anywhere shared (see README's Security Notes section).

Run order: AI-1 (health) → AI-9 (Generate From Match, populates {{lastBatchId}} and {{lastRequirementId}}) → AI-2..AI-8 (version/file/chat/download operations) → AI-10 (download batch).

request.description: No custom /health endpoint exists in RequirementController — this hits Spring Boot's default actuator health endpoint instead. Requires spring-boot-starter-actuator on the classpath and management.endpoints.web.exposure.include=health (add this if actuator isn't already exposed).

item.name: AI-9 Generate From Match (report + project ZIP → generated code)

formdata.description: JSON matching-service report (requirementMatches[]: reqId, reqText, status, score, topChunks[])
ZIP of the target Spring Boot project to modify/extend

request.description:
Input (multipart/form-data):
  report      — JSON file matching MatchReportDto, e.g. { "requirementMatches": [ { "reqId": "FR-1.1", "reqText": "...", "status": "MISSING", "score": 0.2, "topChunks": [ { "filePath": "src/.../UserController.java" } ] } ] }
  projectZip  — ZIP of the existing project to generate/modify code in

For each requirement, the service prompts OpenAI to generate/modify Spring Boot files, stores a GenerationBatch + one GenerationVersion per requirement + GeneratedFile rows.

Expected output: 200 OK, { "batchId": <id>, "versions": [ {...GenerationVersion} ] }. Every AI response is screened by PromptSecurityService, ZipSecurityService, AiResponseValidator and SensitiveDataValidator before being trusted/stored.
Lists all GenerationVersion rows for a requirement, newest version number first.

Note: the path segment here is actually versionId (the DB row id), not versionNumber — the controller method is getVersion(requirementId, versionId). Using {{lastVersionNumber}} works only if version 1's id happens to equal 1; otherwise substitute the real version id from AI-2's response.
Lists every GeneratedFile (path + content) belonging to a specific version, addressed by versionNumber this time.
